sentences.en: The count sketched a graph; another count sketched a count.
sentences.zh: 这位侯爵画了一张图；另一位侯爵画了一个计数。

sentences.en: The graph of the cosecant function has vertical asymptotes.
sentences.zh: 正割函数的图像有垂直渐近线。

sentences.en: The graph shows the cumulative interest as a function of time.
sentences.zh: 这张图显示了随时间变化的累计利息。

senses.zh: 图表，图形；（数学）图形；（计算机科学）图
